title: Problem statement
description: The Aligned product brief: searchable site memory, grounded answers, and proactive issue detection.

description: Recognizing steps, reasoning about valid alternatives, and distinguishing mistakes from successful corrections.

title: Streaming understanding and timely intervention
description: Understanding incoming video and deciding when enough evidence is available to assist or alert.

title: Research on construction
description: Connecting observed work to building elements, plans, requirements, and construction-specific evidence.

title: Related business cases
description: Products that inform Aligned’s requirements and useful operational baselines, kept separate from scientific evidence.

title: Related directions and additional methods
description: Anomaly detection, skill assessment, and feedback beyond predefined procedure graphs.

title: Design synthesis for Aligned
description: A proposed architecture and evaluation plan derived from the review, rather than a single experimentally validated method.

title: Reading plan and glossary
description: A reading sequence for the key ideas, related surveys, and definitions of recurring terms.

title: Review scope and reproducibility
description: Source selection, audit history, evidence limitations, and the distinction between published findings and design synthesis.
